about: A2 any of the three spraggons counts; B6 Spicket spawn/marker by the bridge north of Ardee

entries.why: step 1 offers Spicket, Spackit or Spykit but only a Spicket kill counted; step 1 is now a scripted step that completes when the player holds a spraggon head, which any of the three drops (ClassicQuests Drops); the head is no longer handed out again at step 2 (the hand-in still matches it through CollectItemTemplate)

A2: all three spraggons drop the head (period: "Kill him and he drops Spicket's Head / Spacket's Head / Spykit's Head"); B6: the Spicket event spawn and marker were at the far east edge of Lough Derg (63007,15045), now in the woods west of the river crossing north of Ardee (Connacht 49100,47300; period "appears at night in the woods to the west of the bridge on the road north from Ardee"); until a head is held the marker also points at the nearest Spackit/Spykit
Spackit and Spykit are now quest kills of Spicket, Spackit and Spykit; gamebots leave them alone
